This is an automated audit plus a manual checklist, not a legal opinion or a compliance certification. Nobody can certify a website from a scan alone, and anyone who says otherwise is selling you something.

Anything that needs human judgment: whether alt text actually describes the image, whether the keyboard focus order makes sense, whether a screen reader can get through checkout, whether error messages are announced, whether captions are accurate. Every report ends with a 12-item manual checklist that tells you exactly how to test those yourself, and every finding is flagged as either automated (we saw it fail) or needs manual check (we saw something suspicious).

We start at the address you give us, follow same-site links the way a visitor would, and scan up to 15 pages (30 per site on the Agency 5-Pack) at both desktop and mobile sizes. The start page is always scanned; pages your robots.txt disallows are skipped. The report lists every page we visited and what we found on each.

We store the addresses of the pages we scanned, the axe results for each page, small screenshots of the elements behind the top ten findings, and the report files (PDF, JSON, CSV). We do not keep copies of your pages, and we never store card numbers; payment is handled by Stripe. There are no tracking cookies on this site. See the Privacy page for the full list and retention details.
